sonnet.problem: The joke calls the Millers "my old family." Papa Dorin's family is only his six cookie cutter kids. The Millers are the family whose kitchen he lived in, not his family, so this invents another family. The Stop 3 card 11 callback to "the Millers' kitchen" builds on the same line.
sonnet.rule: His family is only these six kids. There is no wife. **Never invent** a reunion, any news about the kids, or any other family member.
